map.TOML 解析：逐行去空白，跳过空行与 # 注释（# 的判定需避开成对双引号内的: TOML parsing: trim each line and skip blank lines and # comments (the # check must ignore content inside a matched pair of double quotes); [section] builds nested objects level by level along . and becomes the current table, [[array]] appends a new element to the same-named array and becomes the current table (when the path hits an array table, descend into its last element so child tables are not lost); other lines split at the first = into key and value, the key forms a dotted path, and the value has its trailing # comment stripped before parsing; when the value starts with [ or { and the bracket is not closed, following lines are consumed as well, so multi-line arrays work. Value parsing: a double-quoted string is unescaped in a single pass (\\ \n \t \r \" mapped at once, so \\temp is not split into backslash plus tab), true/false become booleans, pure integers via parseInt, pure decimals via parseFloat, [ ] is split on top-level commas (skipping commas inside quotes and nested brackets) and parsed recursively into an array, and an inline { } table is parsed from a=1 pairs into a mapping. Output: keys matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ are written as-is, otherwise double-quoted with backslashes and quotes escaped; strings containing backslashes, newlines, tabs or YAML special characters are double-quoted with escapes, array elements that are mappings expand line by line as - key: value (child tables and arrays recurse with more indentation), scalars are written before child tables within one table, and keys can optionally be sorted alphabetically
